notes.title: 📺 Prepare for Grendizer’s return on the small screen 📺
notes.content:
Hello Earth Defenders,

Almost 50 years after its first appearance on television, the curtain will rise on a new Grendizer in 2024!

[previewyoutube=khvLQriRdBA;full][/previewyoutube]

[Re]discover the iconic robot from outer space in Grendizer U!

Produced by Manga Productions, this brand new anime series will feature epic adventures based on Go Nagai’s characters, starring:
Director Mitsuo Fukuda [Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, Future GPX Cyber Formula Series]
Character Designer Yoshiyuki Sadamoto [Neon Genesis Evangelion, Summer Wars]
Screenwriter Ichiro Okouchi [Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury, Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion]
Composer Kohei Tanaka [One Piece, Sakura Wars Series]
Space and Earth, do you recall my faded memories?
